description: The Institute of Chartered Accountants of Sri Lanka - Amendment to SLFRS for Insurance Contracts Extension  of the temporarily exemption from SLFRS - Reserved (E Only)
reasoning: This gazette content announces the adoption of amendments to Sri Lanka Financial Reporting Standards (SLFRS) and a temporary exemption from SLFRS 9, published under the Sri Lanka Accounting and Auditing Standards Act. It deals with regulatory frameworks, compliance requirements, and statutory instruments related to accounting standards, which falls under Legal/Regulatory matters rather than government structure/personnel changes.
